title: Matplotlib
idiom: cyanotype technical blueprint; icon a bold white spike-and-ripple plot rising from an L-shaped axis corner, weight to the right
hero_prompt: Cyanotype sun-print on hand-coated paper, deep Prussian blue with crisp white lines, uneven brushed blue edges and soft paper texture, flat and graphic, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field: one long, smooth white decaying sine wave sweeping across the whole banner from left to right, tall at the left and settling to calm at the right, above a single straight white horizontal line, with wide empty blue space around it, exact and calm.
icon_prompt: Cyanotype sun-print emblem on hand-coated paper, flat deep Prussian blue filling the whole square with bold white shapes, no shading or gradients, not a photograph, not a 3D render: one thick white L-shaped corner of a graph, a line up the left side and a line along the bottom meeting in the lower-left corner, and starting from the left line one thick white wave that swings up to a tall peak near the left, then rocks in smaller and smaller swings toward the right until it lies flat along the bottom. The mark is lopsided, its weight to the left; nothing centred, no circle, no ring, no crosshair, no border. No tick marks, no grid, no arrowheads. Bold, high-contrast, reads clearly at 24 pixels.

history.icon_prompt: A bold, high-contrast emblem of a single ruled sine curve crossing a straight axis — thick white line on deep blue, no gridlines or fine ticks, reading clearly as a small mark.
